notes: pi mcp add (1.4.0) writes command, args, env, cwd, exposure or url, headers, exposure; `--bearer-token-env-var N` becomes headers.Authorization "Bearer ${N}"; it keeps the file's indentation but rewrites the whole file, ends it with a newline, refuses a file with comments, and replaces an existing name (V, recorded). Probe run 27 Oct (`pi mcp list` starting a stdio server): ${TOKEN} expands in env and stays literal in args (V); an entry with no exposure loads as codemode (V, `pi mcp list` output). `--oauth-client-secret` may be `!command` (pi mcp add --help), so tk refuses any value starting with `!`. Project files are skipped in RPC mode until the project is trusted (rules case 47). Source (v1.4.0): ${VAR} and $VAR expand in env, headers and oauth.clientSecret, `$$` escapes `$`, and a whole value `!cmd` runs a shell command (V, core/resolve-config-value.ts#L140-L151); SSE is rejected; a project entry with no command or url is an override of enabled/exposure only (V). PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR replaces ~/.pi/agent (V, src/config.ts#L584-L611).
